text: dsh-sdd-generator 是面向 DSH Web 的开发工具插件，注册 generate_sdd 工具来扫描指定代码目录并生成软件设计文档提纲。它遍历常见语言的源文件，按顶层目录整理模块清单，提取文件开头摘要，并列出可能的入口点，最终输出 Markdown。用户可设置扫描文件数，默认 200、最多 500，并限制遍历深度为六层。适合需要快速了解代码库结构、起草架构文档的开发者。使用时提供代码库根目录绝对路径，无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-sdd-generator adds a codebase scanning tool to DSH Web. Given a root directory, it returns a Markdown outline with module lists, file summaries, and likely entry points. Developers can use it to map a project before drafting architecture documentation.
想快速整理一个代码库的模块清单和入口文件，生成设计文档提纲。
I want a quick Markdown outline showing the modules and likely entry points in a codebase.
dsh-sdd-generator 的功能「生成设计提纲」：调用 generate_sdd 并提供代码目录后，插件扫描源文件，输出含模块清单、可能入口和补充说明的 Markdown 提纲。

dsh-sdd-generator README · dsh-sdd-generator：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that scans a
codebase and generates a **Software Design Document (SDD)** outline — module inventory,
entry points, and a per-file summary.

dsh-sdd-generator README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sdd-generator
```

The plugin auto-mounts via its `dsh.bundle.patch` declaration (no manual `cordis.patch.yml`
editing needed). Restart `dsh web` afterwards.

dsh-sdd-generator README · Use：In the chat, ask the model to generate an SDD, e.g.:

> "Generate an SDD for C:\Users\me\projects\my-app using the generate_sdd tool"

The model calls the `generate_sdd` tool with:

| param     | type     | description                                  |
| --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| `root`    | string   | Absolute path to the codebase root to scan  |
| `maxFiles`| number   | Cap on files scanned (default 200, max 500) |
dsh-sdd-generator README · Use：The tool returns a Markdown SDD skeleton that the model can then expand into a full document.

dsh-sdd-generator README · Develop：This package ships plain JS (`lib/index.js`) so no build step is required for consumers.

```bash
npm publish        # publish to npm, then others can `dsh plugin add` it
```

Add the `dsh-plugin` topic to the GitHub repo to appear in community listings.
